clips.title: The story
paras: Lost Deathstalkers is a reconnaissance mission assigned by High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher. Two Forsaken scouts, Rane and Quinn Yorick, went missing weeks ago while surveying the haunted farmsteads of northern Silverpine Forest. Tracking them down reveals not only their fate, but the encroaching perils that threaten the Forsaken hold on the region.

The Deathstalkers serve as the eyes, ears, and hidden daggers of Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken. When operatives go silent, command takes notice. High Executor Hadrec deployed the scouts Rane and Quinn Yorick into northern Silverpine Forest weeks ago to monitor the abandoned farms and watch for enemy movements. Having received no courier or report since their departure, Hadrec fears the duo met a grim end at the hands of the Scourge or worse.

Northern Silverpine is rife with danger, situated between the ruined estates of Lordaeron and the shadowed borders of Tirisfal Glades. Wandering undead, prowling beasts, and feral worgen make unescorted travel perilous even for seasoned rogues. Tracking the Yoricks requires searching the dilapidated northern farmsteads where their reconnaissance first began, hoping to recover whatever intelligence they gathered before danger overwhelmed them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine. We have not heard from them.
They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed. Find these Deathstalkers.
Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine. You should begin your search there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found us! And not a moment too soon...
